PROGRAM zcv_screen_modules.

DATA gt_rows TYPE STANDARD TABLE OF i WITH DEFAULT KEY.

* The modules of a direction are lowered into one method; each LOOP AT SCREEN
* still gets a field symbol of its own, none that a module declares itself.
MODULE set_first OUTPUT.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    IF screen-group1 = 'G1'.
      screen-input = 0.
    ENDIF.
    MODIFY SCREEN.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE set_second OUTPUT.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    screen-intensified = 1.
    MODIFY SCREEN.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE fill_rows OUTPUT.
  LOOP AT gt_rows ASSIGNING FIELD-SYMBOL(<ls_state>).
    <ls_state> = 1.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE check_first INPUT.
  LOOP AT SCREEN.
    screen-input = 1.
    MODIFY SCREEN.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDMODULE.

MODULE check_second INPUT.
  LOOP AT SCREEN INTO DATA(ls_screen).
    ls_screen-required = 1.
    MODIFY SCREEN FROM ls_screen.
  ENDLOOP.
ENDMODULE.
